name: What types of damage are considered interior wear and tear?

mainEntity.name: What types of damage are considered interior wear and tear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior wear and tear repair addresses cosmetic and functional damage that builds up from everyday living. This commonly includes scuffed baseboards, door casing gouges, drywall cracks, doorknob holes, settling seams, peeling interior paint, loose floor transitions, and cracked grout or damaged tiles. At HH Remodeling LLC, repair work typically spans multiple trades, combining finish carpentry, drywall patching, texture matching, and painting into one visit so you do not have to hire separate specialty contractors for minor fixes throughout the house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior wear and tear includes everyday damage like drywall scuffs and holes, cracked caulk or grout, dinged baseboards, damaged trim, loose hardware, and chipped paint.
